items.criterion: The readiness endpoint answers 200 from the production build on the container-internal port.
items.judgment: Call the readiness endpoint on the app origin and read the status.

items.criterion: The public projects endpoint returns the three published projects in position order.
items.judgment: Read the response array and compare the slug order against the seeded positions.

items.criterion: The facet query narrows the published set to the projects carrying that facet.
items.judgment: Read the facet-filtered response array and compare the slug set against the seeded facets.

items.criterion: The draft project and its poster answer the owning author alone.
items.judgment: Request the draft route and the draft poster as four callers and compare the four outcomes.

items.criterion: A reader session is refused at every authoring endpoint with the projects table unchanged.
items.judgment: Call the three authoring endpoints with a reader token and re-read the projects count.

items.criterion: Exactly one project row carries the lead flag after two simultaneous promotions.
items.judgment: Fire two promotions at two different projects and count the lead rows afterwards.

items.criterion: The uploaded poster object exists in the bucket at the pinned key scheme.
items.judgment: Upload a known image, compute its digest and look the key up in the bucket.

items.criterion: An identical enquiry replay leaves one stored row carrying the first reference.
items.judgment: Submit the same enquiry twice and count the rows for that address.

items.criterion: The seven tables carry the seeded rows exactly once after a restart.
items.judgment: Count the seeded users, projects, pages and globals rows.

items.criterion: A reserved top-level segment is refused as a project slug with nothing stored.
items.judgment: Attempt a creation for each reserved segment and re-read the projects count.

items.criterion: The wall of work presents the published projects as a mixed-ratio grid drawn from the pinned aspect-ratio tokens.
items.judgment: Open the wall and read the rendered card ratios against the pinned token set.

items.criterion: The intro overlay hands a visitor into the entered experience with the chosen audio state intact.
items.judgment: Press each door in turn and read the resulting mute state on the next route.
